sonnet.problem: The two right words could swap places. "Brick instead of mortar and tar instead of stone" reads as fine English, so each right word does not fit only its own blank. Use one blank or another question type.
sonnet.rule: With two blanks, each right word fits only its own blank. If the two right words could swap places, use one blank or another question type.

sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers "dreams" and "visions" mean nearly the same thing, so they are near-matches of each other.
sonnet.rule: Two wrong answers never mean the same as each other either.
